subject: Proposed MAP & security sprint — FirstHarbor evaluation timeline
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@firstharbor.com>, procurement <procurement@firstharbor.com>
Cc: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@lawson-advisors.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Proposed MAP & security sprint — FirstHarbor evaluation timeline

Hi Samantha / FirstHarbor procurement team,

Thanks for the productive demo last week. To keep momentum and make the security/compliance gating explicit for the evaluation, I’ve sketched a short Mutual Action Plan (attached) that focuses the next three weeks on the items your risk and procurement teams asked about. High level:

- Week 1 (this week): SOC 2 snapshot & clarifying scope, SIG/CAIQ initial answers, and DPA redline start.
- Week 2: Evidence intake for SOC 2 controls we listed (configs, access lists), final SIG answers, and DPA comment loop with your legal.
- Week 3: Confirm data retention policy for PII/non-PII, finalize DPA signatures, and closure call to convert to pilot contract.

Top asks from your side we want to confirm now:
1) Data residency expectations (US-only vs EU for any EU customers you might route)
2) Retention windows for logs and application data (default vs custom retention)
3) Any additional in-scope systems for SOC 2 beyond the API + control plane we demonstrated
I’m attaching the MAP-baseline.pdf and a short SOC2-snapshot.pdf that summarize what we can produce in 48 hours. I’ve also attached a stub SIG-CAIQ workbook we’ll fill in — that intake can be parallelized.

Proposed next steps:
- Can you confirm the primary compliance contact for FirstHarbor (security/infosec + procurement)?
- If we get SOC 2 snapshot + SIG answers back by EOD Friday, we can have a DPA redline ready for your counsel by Tuesday.

I’ll coordinate internal owners once you confirm contacts — suggested ownership below: Marcus will own the SOC 2 snapshot, Irene will run SIG/CAIQ intake, and Rishi will draft the DPA comment set.

Thanks,

Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwood.com | +1 415-555-0124
[Attachment: MAP-baseline.pdf] [Attachment: SOC2-snapshot.pdf] [Attachment: SIG-CAIQ-answers.xlsx]
From: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@firstharbor.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
Cc: procurement <procurement@firstharbor.com>, Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@lawson-advisors.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposed MAP & security sprint — FirstHarbor evaluation timeline

Grace — thanks for this and the clear plan. A few quick clarifications from our side before we lock timelines:

- Data residency: our platform must keep all FirstHarbor customer data (PII and transaction metadata) in the US for now. We may require an EU option for a later stage, but for this eval assume US-only.
- Retention: our security policy default is 90 days for application logs and 7 years for transactional records tied to banking operations. We need to know the options you support for aligning to these windows (i.e., configurable retention per tenancy vs global policy).
- SOC 2 scope: please confirm whether your SOC 2 report covers dedicated customer environments or only your hosted control plane; we need evidence for the hosted API + encryption at rest and in transit.

Looping in our counsel Alex — he’ll run an initial read of the DPA redline once you have it.

If you can confirm answers above and share the SOC2 snapshot by Friday, we’ll aim to review the SIG workbook next Monday and get DPA comments back by Wednesday.

— Samantha
Samantha Lee
Head of Security & Risk | FirstHarbor Bank
samantha.lee@firstharbor.com
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 10 Mar 2027 12:08:00 -07:00
Subject: FW: Proposed MAP & security sprint — FirstHarbor evaluation timeline

Marcus / Irene / Rishi — forwarding FirstHarbor’s clarifying asks. Please commit owners and timelines below so I can reply with concrete deliverables.

Action items (owner / ETA):
- SOC 2 snapshot (covers hosted control plane + what we can provide per-tenant): Marcus / Thu EOD (we’ll attach SOC2-snapshot.pdf + supporting index).
- SIG/CAIQ intake — populate answers for the 200 Qs initially flagged: Irene / Mon (next week) draft; we’ll mark any open items for FH.
- DPA redline (addressing retention windows, subprocessor list, breach notification SLA): Rishi / Tue next week (will include comments we can push to DocuSign).
- Retention options doc (configurable per-tenant toggles, default windows, logs vs transactional data): Marcus + Rishi / Fri this week.

Notes: For the retention conversation, remember FirstHarbor’s ask: 90 days logs, 7 years transactions. We support per-tenant retention configuration in Dedicated; for hosted we offer configurable retention at the customer level via org settings (we need to confirm the retention SLA language for the DPA).

Please reply with brief ack and any timeline conflicts.

Thanks,
Grace
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwood.com>
To: Samantha Lee <samantha.lee@firstharbor.com>, procurement <procurement@firstharbor.com>
Cc: Alex Byrne <alex.byrne@lawson-advisors.com>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.com>, Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 17 Mar 2027 14:48:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Proposed MAP & security sprint — FirstHarbor evaluation timeline

Hi Samantha / Alex / procurement,

Appended the deliverables for this sprint and next steps. We’ve attached: SOC2-snapshot.pdf (control scope + evidence index), SIG-CAIQ-answers.xlsx (tabbed by owner — highlighted open Qs), and DPA-redline-v1.docx (our initial comments). Key callouts:

- Residency & retention: Redwood supports US-only residency for customer data. For retention we offer: configurable retention per org for logs (min 30d, max 3650d) and a transactional-records retention policy that can be set to match regulatory asks — we’ll put the 90-day / 7-year examples into the DPA appendix. See retention table in SOC2-snapshot.pdf.
- SOC 2 scope: the snapshot covers the hosted control plane and production runtime; we call out what customers can evidence at-tenant level (audit logs, API key rotation logs, TLS configs). If FirstHarbor needs Dedicated (per-tenant isolated infra) for audit purposes, we can scope that as an option in the MAP.
- SIG open items: we flagged network diagram details and third-party subprocessor attestations — Irene has added notes and a recommended next-step list.

Next steps:
1) Please confirm an internal reviewer for the SOC2-snapshot and SIG workbook by Fri, Mar 19.
2) Alex — if your counsel has initial DPA comments after reviewing DPA-redline-v1, we’ll pick up the negotiation cadence. We can push the DPA to DocuSign once redlines are agreed (link: https://app.docusign.com/link/to/DPA-FH-117).
3) Proposed checkpoint: 30 Mar — wrap evidence intake and sign DPA for pilot.

I’ll follow up with calendar invites for two working sessions (SIG intake + DPA review).

Best,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Solutions Lead | Redwood Inference
[Attachment: SOC2-snapshot.pdf] [Attachment: SIG-CAIQ-answers.xlsx] [Attachment: DPA-redline-v1.docx]
